hero.oneLiner: Chavda Infra positions itself as a one-stop-shop, fully-integrated EPC player that has transitioned from a small Ahmedabad repair-works contractor into a preferred high-rise construction partner for India's leading developers, riding structural tailwinds in Gujarat's real estate market.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Fully integrated EPC company spanning the entire real estate value chain (planning, design, engineering, procurement, construction, quality assurance), present in Ahmedabad, GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Rajkot and Baroda.
- Repeatedly serviced 75+ clients across Gujarat with inbound/repeat orders from groups such as Shivalik, A Shridhar, Nirma, Rajshree, Sanghavi, HN Safal, Ratna, Lilamani and Avani, driven by construction quality and faster turnaround.
- Transitioned from a private-bungalow repair contractor founded in 1990 to a leading EPC player building skyscrapers up to 140+ meters tall; can execute landmark projects up to ~₹785 crores.
- Outstanding contract value of key top-tier client projects stood at ₹810+ crores as of Q1 FY27.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Net Debt to Equity improved to 0.6x (FY26) from 1.4x in FY25, though the associated preferential-issue fund infusion moderated ROE (to 7.7%) and ROCE (to 11.5%).
- Raised ₹43 crores via IPO on NSE Emerge (Sep 2023); promoter holding stood at 73% as of Mar 31, 2025.
- Capital allocation philosophy favors quality/margin-accretive project selection over pure order-book growth, and reinvestment into refurbishing yard, RMC plants and imported technology to support scale.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Group structure] Chavda group comprises three entities: Chavda Infra Limited (listed; construction services provider; 73% promoter holding), Chavda RMC LLP (privately owned by promoter family; RMC plant business), and Chavda Developers Private Limited (privately owned by promoter family; real-estate developer).
- [Management commentary] Q1 FY27 profitability was impacted by temporary, transitory labor-related challenges, viewed by management as an external factor with a healthy recovery expected as execution/operational efficiency strengthens.
- [Leadership] Key management includes Mahesh Chavda (MD & Chairman, 40+ yrs experience, founded the company in 1990), Johil Chavda (Director), Jeet Chavda (Promoter Group), Parth Gurjar (CEO, associated since 2004, 20+ yrs experience) and Mayank Shah (Chartered Accountant/CFO, associated since 2022).
